Um Design System para fazer um ecossiste: A Design System to make an ecosystem feel like one product.
A empresa cresceu para múltiplas platafo: The company expanded into multiple platforms, but the interface language did not keep up. The result was fragmentation for users and rework for teams. The challenge was to build a shared foundation of components, tokens and governance that could scale with the product.
Tokens, escalas, feedbacks, componentes: Tokens, scales, feedback patterns, components and documentation created to reduce repeated decisions and restore coherence across the ecosystem.
Os produtos estavam escalando mais rápid: Products were scaling faster than the interface language, and every new initiative increased consistency debt.
O Design System não nasceu para deixar a: The Design System was not created to make screens identical. It was created to reduce the cost of making them different.
Produtos distintos haviam evoluído com b: Different products had evolved with their own libraries, components and patterns. The work was to create a shared language that increased consistency for users and predictability for design and engineering.
Cada produto parecia pertencer a uma emp: Each product looked like it belonged to a different company.
A Empresa X expandiu sua atuação para CX: The company expanded into CX, administrative tools, a collection platform, a client area and other products. That growth happened at different speeds and with independent visual libraries.
Para o usuário, a navegação entre produt: For users, moving between products meant changes in interface, behavior and hierarchy. For teams, the cost appeared as rebuilt components, inconsistent handoffs and harder maintenance.
Como unificar o ecossistema sem criar um: How could we unify the ecosystem without creating a system so rigid that products could no longer evolve?
Antes de desenhar a biblioteca, precisáv: Before designing the library, we needed to measure the debt.
Começamos por uma auditoria completa das: We began with a full audit of existing interfaces. We cataloged components, visual patterns, states and redundancies, then combined that diagnosis with interviews with designers, engineers and product stakeholders.
Também analisamos referências como Mater: We also analyzed references such as Material 3, Atlassian and IBM Carbon to understand documentation, structure and governance practices that could be adapted to the company context.
A biblioteca era só uma parte. O produto: The library was only one part. The real product was the adoption process.
O sistema foi pensado para ser modular,: The system was designed to be modular, documented and easy to adopt. The goal was to reduce repeated decisions without turning the Design System into a bureaucratic layer.
O valor do sistema aparece quando a mesm: The system’s value appears when the same rule works across different products.
Os primeiros componentes foram testados: The first components were tested in real contexts, allowing us to adjust proportions, hierarchy and behavior before consolidating patterns. The comparisons below show the language shift across two parts of the ecosystem.
Padronizar não era fazer todos os produt: Standardizing did not mean making every product look identical. It meant ensuring equivalent decisions followed the same logic, quality level and shared foundation.
O sistema foi validado no trabalho real,: The system was validated in real work, not on a documentation page.
Os componentes foram aplicados em telas: Components were applied to real screens to assess not only appearance, but also system efficiency in use, handoff flow and the reduction of inconsistencies during sprints.
Um sistema só escala quando deixa de per: A system only scales when it stops belonging to one person.
O Design System foi desenvolvido em parc: The Design System was developed in partnership with designer Isabela Lobato. We worked on guidelines, microinteraction reviews and the balance between standardization and flexibility.
The visual foundation became an operational foundation.
Uma fundação comum sem apagar a função d: A shared foundation without erasing each product’s role.
